doc.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005

title: Music as his only work
summary: He never considered other work; music was everything to him.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Did you ever consider any other kind of work?
You never had a non-musical job?

No. Music was one hundred percent. Maybe a hundred and ten percent. No. I didn’t care for anything else but to play that horn and perfect, perfect, perfect. ‘Til this day she can tell you, ooh I get mad at myself sometimes.
How much did it cost for a room for a week in New York at that time.
